skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic knowledge of rural economic planning.
Understand and apply basic knowledge of rural social planning.
Understand and apply basic knowledge of rural environmental planning.
Understand and apply basic knowledge of agricultural planning.
Understand and apply basic knowledge of rural industrial planning.
Understand and apply basic knowledge of rural service sector planning.
Understand and apply basic knowledge of project management in rural development.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate and critique rural development plans.
Develop collaboration skills to work effectively in teams on rural development projects.
Develop self-learning skills to continue education in higher levels.
Develop discipline and responsibility in class and project work.
Develop communication skills to effectively present and discuss rural development plans.
